title: HUMAN SERVICES INTERNSHIP
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 12 credits
description: Emphasizes field experience to apply theory and evidence-based practices to individual, family, and community problems in professional settings. Supervision by agency and instructor. Includes reflection and constructive criticism processes.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: HDFS 262, 310 and 462.
A minimum grade of C- is required in HDFS 262 and HDFS 462.
A minimum grade of P is required in HDFS 310.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a major in Human Devel and Family Science (447).
